title: Concept: TLS verification disabled (go) — review required
description: In go, InsecureSkipVerifys*:s*true disables a TLS authenticity check. Without verification, encryption still runs but against whoever answers — including an attacker. The remedy is restoring verification (system roots plus private CA pool).
applicability: go TLS clients and configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Machine-in-the-middle interception of all traffic on the connection; HIGH severity.
